# Design topic index

<!-- Generated by `ghmem index` from the topic docs. Do not edit. -->

- [autocompletion](autocompletion.md) — What "autocomplete" means in micro — Tab-driven command-bar completion, buffer-word completion and the core completion framework — why language-aware completion is pushed out to plugins (Jedi, gocode, LSP) rather than built into core, and why the plugin-facing completion API promised in 2019 still has not arrived. (#1138, #174, #977, #175, #463, …)
- [clipboard-behavior](clipboard-behavior.md) — Why copy/paste in micro behaves differently locally vs. over ssh, how the internal/external/terminal clipboard backends and Ctrl-C vs Ctrl-Shift-C selections relate, and where maintainers draw the line between a micro bug and a terminal-emulator limitation. (#93, #2238, #305, #61)
- [debian-packaging](debian-packaging.md) — How micro got into apt — the seven-year path from "add to apt" to official Debian/Ubuntu repos, why upstream delegates distro packaging to volunteer Debian maintainers instead of running its own PPA or apt repo, how Debian's one-source-package-per-upstream rule collided with micro's vendored git-submodule dependencies, why the Debian build uses debian/rules rather than micro's makefile, and why distro versions lag upstream releases. (#1, #583, #1093, #562, #1506, …)
- [file-tree-sidebar](file-tree-sidebar.md) — Whether micro's core should ship a file-tree sidebar / file browser / project pane, why six years of demand was routed to the filetree and filemanager plugins instead, the plugin-API limits (no mouse input to plugins, per-buffer scope) that keep those plugins from feeling native, and the recurring "terminal editor, not an IDE" scope line. (#249, #515, #823, #243, #1278, …)
- [lsp-support](lsp-support.md) — Why micro has no built-in Language Server Protocol client, the owner's 2020 "next after the keybinding rework" roadmap statement that never landed, the out-of-core AndCake/micro-plugin-lsp Lua client (`micro --plugin install lsp`, gopls/pylsp/clangd/zls, alt-K hover / alt-D definition), and the reporter-initiated Won't Do close of the project's most-reacted feature request. (#1138, #174, #3231)
